status: registered; parameters frozen; any change requires a new version

v1.historyPool: verified 90-minute result, both team IDs, kickoff + 5400 s before the stage cutoff, same company

rule.quoteUsed: last Royal asia quote at or before kickoff - 600 s (V1 points cleaning)
rule.x.25 line: receiving team (a draw is a half win)
rule.x.75 line: giving team (winning by exactly one is a half win)
rule.whole, half or level line: lower-water team; the giving team (home on a level line) on equal water

gates.G_V1_T120: V1 at T-120 is non-neutral and its team equals the rule team (team = giver at the T-120 line if D > 50, else the other team)
gates.G_V1_T10: V1 at T-10 is missing, neutral, or its team equals the rule team
gates.G_LINE: signed line move from the first valid prematch Royal quote to the T-10 quote is toward the rule team (it now gives more or receives less)

levels.L0: rule only (recorded for every eligible match as the comparison base)

eligibility.competitions: all; first-tier flag recorded for the secondary analysis
eligibility.lateDecision: generated at or after kickoff: recorded, flagged late, excluded from evaluation

settlement: frozen team, line and that team's water from the T-10 quote; verified regular-time 90-minute score including stoppage time
winRate: (win + half_win) / (win + half_win + half_loss + loss); push excluded

baseline.purpose: expected win rate from price and line type alone; lift = actual - expected
baseline.model: logit P(upper wins) = sum over line fraction f in (0, .25, .5, .75) of [a_f + b_f * logit(de-margined upper probability)] * I(fraction = f)

evaluation.primaryHypothesis: L2 win rate exceeds L0 win rate on prospective, non-late decisions

historicalReference: filled by forward_rule.py backtest; see RULES.md
